campaign.purpose: frozen held-out, long-run and active-era validation before fuel/mass work

verdicts.reason: Every active physical vehicle resource executes on the held-out circuits.
Held-out circuit and vehicle groups do not share one universal coarse setup optimum.
Compounds produce observable long-run time and final-wear differences.
One reviewed one-stop window is universally fastest.
Enabled eras 1 through 5, including explicit era 3 and 4 anchors, execute deterministically.
The candidate output does not expose initial, per-lap or final fuel mass, so mass evolution cannot yet be independently audited.
This campaign validates a frozen offline candidate; it does not authorize production or opponent-policy changes.
